source_status.exact_result: Unverified complete proof draft: for every finite Galois E/K, K complete nontrivially valued, and every actual good separated strict boundaryless pure n-dimensional K-analytic X with n>=1, every finite continuous real h satisfies ordinary d'd''[h]=0 if and only if ordinary d'd''[h_E]=0 against all compact complementary (n-1,n-1) tests. Forward transport uses stabilizer induction and norm/collar approximation; reverse uses canonical scalar projection without [E:K].
concrete_gaps: Original P06.2 remains open: no general two-sign positive-current regularization or other bridge from arbitrary continuous current vanishing to the classical curve-test notion is proved.
No completed-algebraic ascent is established: exact finite-stage descent and gluing of arbitrary complementary ordinary forms remain a separate obligation.

Purely inseparable, mixed-finite and transcendental ascent are not established in this run; no all-dimensional classical recognition or first-stage psh regularization follows from the finite-Galois gate alone.
